prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover, trunk lid and both tail lamp assemblies show the damage expected from a rear-end impact, and the crush pattern on the rear panel matches the reported direction of force. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the inspection. The labor hours listed fit the scope of work required to replace and refinish the affected parts. Two similar charges posted on the same day are being verified against the invoices before approval. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover, trunk lid and lamps, repair the rear panel, then refinish and recalibrate the rear sensors.
